# Brand assets

The RankRaft AI mark, copied from the brand kit (`packages/brand` in the main
repository: the rounded square with the r-wave glyph, ink `#16171a` on paper
`#f5f4ef`). Two files because the kit ships two: the same geometry with the
colours swapped for light and dark pages. Do not edit the path — it is the
artwork. Lime `#c8f03c` is the accent and is not used in the mark.
